formats.name: jtorch-checkpoint
formats.notes: Versioned JSON manifest, little-endian payload, SHA-256 digest; corruption, truncation and bad magic are rejected. Supported dtypes: float32/float64/int32/int64/bool/complex64/complex128.

formats.name: safetensors
formats.notes: Reader and writer; reference file produced by safetensors 0.7.0 is read, and length/offset tampering is rejected. Complex dtypes are rejected explicitly (Safetensors has no complex entry in this build).

formats.name: onnx
formats.notes: Import-only inference foundations (interop/jtorch-onnx, opset 13-23): Identity/Add/Sub/Mul/Div/Neg/Abs/Exp/Log/Sigmoid/Relu/MatMul/Gemm/Softmax/Flatten/Transpose/Reshape/Concat/Squeeze/Unsqueeze/Gather/Conv/MaxPool/AveragePool/Constant/BatchNormalization. Unsupported operators are reported before execution; external tensor data and ONNX export are not implemented.

unsupported: ONNX export and external tensor data
safetensors metadata blocks (ignored on read, not written)
